english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is wholly or completely so.
Use 完全 as the all-purpose adverb for totality, including being completely broke.
This is the all-purpose choice for “completely,” as in 完全清醒 for “wide awake.”
Use this as the all-purpose adverb for “completely” or “entirely.”
Use this as the all-purpose choice when “perfectly” means completely or totally, especially before an adjective or verb phrase.
This is the all-purpose choice for both “thoroughly” and “totally,” including “completely mad.”
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is completely or entirely so.
This is the all-purpose choice for meaning completely or to the full extent.
Use 完全 as the all-purpose choice for saying that something is complete or wholly so.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is radically or entirely different.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for saying that something is completely or thoroughly done or true.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is completely or entirely so.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is completely or entirely so, as in “completely wrong.”
Use this when “quite” means completely or in full, especially before verbs such as 同意.
Use 完全 when “well” means completely or fully rather than merely to a high degree.
Use this when “absolutely” means completely or wholly, especially with negatives or descriptions of a state.
